desc: Ideation and problem analysis (Structure: $X = Y^2$ where $Y$ has exactly 2 distinct prime factors).
Plan precomputation strategy (Sieve + nested loops for $p^k q^m \le 10^6$).
Write Python code implementing the Sieve, generation of numbers with exactly 2 distinct prime factors up to $10^6$, sorting, and processing queries with binary search.
Run the code against the sample input to verify correctness.
Check for potential TLE (Time Limit Exceeded) if the generation step is too slow.
Ensure input reading handles large inputs efficiently (using `sys.stdin.read`).
